Proof of reproduction of Experimento 02

Source: vignettes/articles/reproduce-experimento02.Rmd
reproduce-experimento02.Rmd

pelagicOM packages the simulation of Experimento 02 (workshop tRFMO CPUE, 2026). The original scripts are Simulacao_Biomassa/ (Part I) and Simulacao_Pesca/ (Part II). The BET_ICCAT preset must reproduce them bit for bit. This page explains how that is checked and records the result.

Why the results are identical

  • Every module is a line-by-line port of the original code. The random draws happen in the same order and use the same seeds: one seed for Part I and one per process in Part II.
  • The RNG kinds are set explicitly (Mersenne-Twister, Inversion, Rejection). A user-level RNGkind() therefore cannot change the results, and the caller’s random stream is restored at the end.
  • The spatial domain is the same. The bundled ICCAT grid is built from ICCAT_gis.gpkg by om_domain_from_gpkg(), with geodesic areas from lwgeom, and the build stops unless cells, lattice and polygons are identical to the saved domain of the experiment (data-raw/build_iccat_grid.R).
  • The generalisations of the package (free regions, envelope on absolute latitude, user habitat layers, any fleets) all have neutral defaults.

How to run the proof

The reference files of Experimento 02 are not distributed with the package. With the experiment folder at hand:

Rscript -e 'source(system.file("scripts", "reproduce_experimento02.R",
                               package = "pelagicOM"))' \
        --args R-Work/Experimento_02
# or
PELAGICOM_EXP02=R-Work/Experimento_02 \
    Rscript $(Rscript -e 'cat(system.file("scripts", "reproduce_experimento02.R", package = "pelagicOM"))')

or, in R:

library(pelagicOM)
run <- om_run("BET_ICCAT")                       # ~15 s
om_compare_reference(run, "R-Work/Experimento_02")

The same comparison runs as a unit test when the environment variable PELAGICOM_EXP02 points to the experiment folder:

PELAGICOM_EXP02=$PWD/Experimento_02 Rscript -e 'devtools::test("pelagicOM")'

Result (pelagicOM 0.1.3, 2026-11-22)

All comparisons use identical(), i.e. bit-for-bit equality:

scenario 08_R02_without_hbf 1,021,802 TRUE 0

caller RNG stream preserved 1 TRUE 0

Two further checks were made:

  • Every CSV written by om_run(dir = ...) has the same text as the CSV of the experiment. This covers 5 biomass tables (population, regional summary, centre of gravity, envelope parameters, cells), 4 fishery tables (fleets, vessels, trips, vessel effects) and the 17 diagnostic tables.
  • A simulation that reads the GeoPackage directly (spatial = list(source = "gpkg", gpkg = ...)) gives the same biomass and long table.

Environment of the check: R 4.5.2, sf 1.1.2, lwgeom 0.2.17, GEOS 3.12.1, GDAL 3.8.4, PROJ 9.4.0, R’s reference BLAS. Biomass and fishery depend on R’s random number generator and on floating-point arithmetic. An optimised BLAS (used in the matrix products of the random fields) may change the last digits. The geometry checks depend on the GEOS / PROJ versions.
